subject: Security & Compliance Discovery - SOC 2 status and roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security & Compliance Discovery - SOC 2 status and roadmap

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Recap:
- You're evaluating vendors for LLM inference across customer-facing features (payment risk scoring, KYC assistance).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 coverage for production environment, GDPR data residency, and HIPAA controls for a subset of workloads.
- FinCo's procurement requires a completed vendor security questionnaire and most-recent SOC 2 report before SIV (security & legal review).

Proposed next steps:
1) You to share the vendor security questionnaire (if you have a canonical PDF/form).
2) We'll provide: a) latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), b) summary of encryption/KMS practices, c) list of certs & roadmap items (ISO 27001, FedRAMP evaluation timeline).
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week with your security team to walk the questionnaire and clarify scoping questions.

Deliverables timeline (proposed):
- Today/Tomorrow: We'll send SOC 2 summary + redacted report and a short security summary doc.
- By EOD Thu 2026-08-27: complete answers to your vendor questionnaire (if you send it today).

Attachments I'll include now: redwood-inference-security-summary.pdf, SOC2-Report-2025.pdf.

If that looks good, can you please: (a) share the questionnaire, and (b) propose 2 slots next week for the security walkthrough?

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinCo Security <security@finco.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance Discovery - SOC 2 status and roadmap

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear notes. Attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire (FinCo_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf). A couple of clarifications from our security team to start: 

- SOC 2: We need the latest Type II report covering the production environment where customer data is processed. If there are any exclusions or subservice orgs, please call them out.
- GDPR: We expect vendor contractual commitments for EU data subjects; can you confirm whether Redwood offers EU data residency and processing controls?
- HIPAA: For the scoped workloads, we'll need a BAA. Is Redwood able to sign a standard BAA or do you work off an addendum?

Proposed times for the walkthrough next week (ET):
- Tue 2026-08-31 10:00 - 10:30
- Wed 2026-09-01 14:30 - 15:00

I'll loop in our security engineer (security@finco.com) on the call invite when we confirm.

Thanks,
Alice Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager | FinCo Capital
alice.bennett@finco.com

Attachment: FinCo_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance Discovery - SOC 2 status and roadmap

Hi Alice,

Appreciate the quick reply and the questionnaire, got it. Answers and supporting artifacts attached. A few highlights inline below and in the attached summary: 

SOC 2:
- Attached is a redacted SOC 2 Type II report covering cloud-hosted production (SOC2-Report-2025.pdf). No subservice org exclusions for customer data processing.
- We maintain quarterly control assessments and an annual Type II audit.

GDPR / EU residency:
- We offer EU data residency in EU regions via our Dedicated and Private deployment options; hosted customers can be restricted to EU regions on request (contract addendum available).

HIPAA / BAA:
- Redwood supports HIPAA-scoped workloads on Dedicated and Private deployments. We have a standard BAA template; legal can iterate if you have edits.

Roadmap items (compliance expansion):
- ISO 27001: In scope for Q4 2026 (internal controls mapped; gap remediation underway).
- SOC scope expansion (logging & audit retention for expanded product surfaces): target H1 2027.
- FedRAMP: exploratory discussions kicked off in 2026; no committed timeline yet - we can share preliminary requirements mapping if that helps.

Next steps:
- I'll upload our completed questionnaire answers to the Drive link below and send a calendar invite for Tue 2026-08-31 10:00 ET unless you prefer the Wed slot.
- Rishi (cc) can join the call to take any technical deep-dive questions. Lauren will own contract/BAA follow-up if we move forward.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-security-evidence

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood-inference-security-summary.pdf, SOC2-Report-2025.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@finco.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & Compliance Discovery - SOC 2 status and roadmap

Hi all,

Quick note from the tech side ahead of the walkthrough: 

- For GDPR: when customers require EU residency we typically provision Dedicated capacity in EU regions or a Private VPC deploy; data-at-rest encryption is enforced and keys can be customer-managed via KMS. I can share a short architecture diagram on the call.
- For HIPAA: our control set covers access logging, encryption-in-transit & at-rest, and audit trails; on Dedicated we enable stricter retention and monitoring policies.
- For FedRAMP: the mapping work shows the largest effort will be continuous monitoring & documentation (CM/IR/MA). If FinCo has an initial set of prioritised requirements we can map them to our roadmap to provide a clearer timeline.

I'll be on the Tue 10:00 ET call. Please send the calendar invite - I'll bring the architecture notes and a short checklist for the SOC scope discussion.

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks - I've scheduled the security walkthrough for Tue, 2026-08-31 10:00 ET and sent an invite to security@finco.com.

A couple follow-ups from procurement side: 
- I've attached our standard BAA and a redlined sample we've used with other financial customers. If you could share FinCo's BAA comments ahead of the call we'll have legal ready to iterate quickly.
- For the questionnaire, if there are any questions you want us to pre-answer in more depth please flag them and we'll prioritize those sections.

Looking forward to the call.

Regards,
